title: True Coloured Concrete
description: To make your concrete a true, solid colour.
body:
True Coloured Concrete gives concrete a solid look while keeping the vanilla textures. Compatable with many resource packs.

How to install
 - Download True Coloured Concrete according to the version you use
 - Open file explorer
 - Copy or move the .zip file to C:\Users\{USER}\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks

If using with another resource pack:
- Move the loaded resource pack above the resource pack you are using with it

[True Black Concrete](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/true-black-concrete)
